definitions.explanation: An indication or sign that something is about to happen. Can be used for both positive and negative future events.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}の{予兆|よちょう}
{何|なに}か{不吉|ふきつ}な{予兆|よちょう}を{感|かん}じた。
{景気回復|けいきかいふく}の{予兆|よちょう}が{見|み}え{始|はじ}めている。
examples.english: Signs of economic recovery are beginning to appear.

notes:
USAGE: {予兆|よちょう} is used for observable signs or indications of future events. It can apply to natural phenomena, social trends, or personal situations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予兆|よちょう}を{感|かん}じる (to sense an omen)
- {予兆|よちょう}が{見|み}える/ある (signs appear/exist)
- {不吉|ふきつ}な{予兆|よちょう} (ominous sign)
- {病気|びょうき}/{災害|さいがい}の{予兆|よちょう} (sign of illness/disaster)

RELATED WORDS:
- {前兆|ぜんちょう} (forewarning - similar but often more concrete)
- {兆候|ちょうこう} (symptom, sign - more neutral/clinical)
- {兆|きざ}し (sign, indication - native Japanese word)
